name: Specific PANTHER Family Causal Bridge
plain_language_rule: Predict treatment when The candidate drug independently affects the same disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:affects, biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates. All more-specific descendants are explicitly excluded, leaving only biolink:affects.; Chemical causally affects regulator in the decreased direction for activity, activity_or_abundance The pinned descendant closure is biolink:affects, biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates. All more-specific descendants are explicitly excluded, leaving only biolink:affects. At least one primary source must be infores:chembl, infores:gtopdb, infores:drugcentral.; The drug target belongs to the PANTHER gene family The pinned descendant closure is biolink:member_of. At least one primary source must be infores:panther.; The distinct disease-associated gene belongs to the same PANTHER family The pinned descendant closure is biolink:member_of. At least one primary source must be infores:panther.; The downstream gene causes or contributes to the disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:causes, biolink:contributes_to. The upstream regulator and downstream disease gene must be distinct. The family must contain at most fourteen distinct GeneOrGeneProduct nodes through PANTHER member-of edges. Fourteen is the observed 90th percentile across all graph PANTHER families. Every distinct gene in the complete PANTHER family is counted The pinned descendant closure is biolink:member_of. At least one primary source must be infores:panther.

derived_features.name: complete curated causal drug-target access path
derived_features.definition: A stored Drug-to-GeneOrGeneProduct relationship exists for a causes-qualified member of the full affects descendant closure with ChEMBL, Guide to Pharmacology, or DrugCentral primary-source support.
inputs: The full pinned affects descendant closure on Drug-to-GeneOrGeneProduct edges
derived_features.construction: Filter raw edges by causes qualification and any of the three sources, group by canonical endpoint pair, count distinct raw relationship identities, and merge one compact relationship per pair. Missing qualifiers or source arrays do not qualify. The rule uses only presence, then rematches raw edges with its recorded exact predicates, qualifiers, and sources. Removing the initial access-path MATCH and WITH before the marked comment gives the otherwise identical unmaterialized query.
derived_features.formula: compact presence iff count(distinct qualifying raw relationship)>0
derived_features.interpretation: This is a query acceleration, not a prediction threshold or an extra biological condition. Full-closure and exact-filtered target rules both rematch their own raw evidence. No training or held-out treatment labels define the access path.

derived_features.name: complete PANTHER family member degree
derived_features.definition: The number of distinct canonical GeneOrGeneProduct members of a family through member_of edges with PANTHER primary provenance.
inputs: All original gene-to-family member_of edges with infores:panther primary-source support
derived_features.construction: For each candidate family, count distinct endpoint gene nodes across its entire incoming qualifying membership neighborhood, not only drug targets or disease genes.
derived_features.formula: family_degree=count(distinct qualifying member genes); require family_degree<=14
derived_features.interpretation: The fixed all-family 90th-percentile bound penalizes large families. It does not imply functional equivalence or shared tissue context.

mechanism.rationale: Excluding the largest evolutionary families may suppress generic family similarity while retaining the independently observed drug and disease arms. Association does not establish a corrective clinical mechanism.

execution.cypher_template: MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[compact:MINER_R0004_CURATED_TARGET]->(regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE compact.artifact_id='r0004-curated-causal-target-v1' WITH DISTINCT chemical,regulator /* END CURATED ACCESS PATH */ MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[direct:{{relationship_types:direct}}]->(disease:Disease) WHERE direct.predicate IN {{predicates:direct}} MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[target:{{relationship_types:target}}]->(regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE target.predicate IN {{predicates:target}} AND target.qualified_predicate = "biolink:causes" AND target.object_direction_qualifier = "decreased" AND target.object_aspect_qualifier IN ["activity","activity_or_abundance"] AND any(source IN ["infores:chembl","infores:gtopdb","infores:drugcentral"] WHERE source IN coalesce(target.primary_knowledge_sources,[])) MATCH (regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[target_member:{{relationship_types:target_member}}]->(family:GeneFamily) WHERE target_member.predicate IN {{predicates:target_member}} AND any(source IN ["infores:panther"] WHERE source IN coalesce(target_member.primary_knowledge_sources,[])) MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[disease_member:{{relationship_types:disease_member}}]->(family:GeneFamily) WHERE disease_member.predicate IN {{predicates:disease_member}} AND any(source IN ["infores:panther"] WHERE source IN coalesce(disease_member.primary_knowledge_sources,[])) MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[causal:{{relationship_types:causal}}]->(disease:Disease) WHERE causal.predicate IN {{predicates:causal}} AND (regulator<>gene) WITH DISTINCT chemical,disease,family CALL { WITH family MATCH (member:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[member_count:{{relationship_types:member_count}}]->(family:GeneFamily) WHERE member_count.predicate IN {{predicates:member_count}} AND any(source IN ["infores:panther"] WHERE source IN coalesce(member_count.primary_knowledge_sources,[])) RETURN count(DISTINCT member) AS family_degree } WITH chemical,disease,family,family_degree WHERE family_degree<=14 RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,count(DISTINCT family) AS support_count

trapi.limitations: Outside TRAPI: direct: discard exact predicates biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates; target: discard exact predicates biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates; target: enforce primary-source membership in infores:chembl, infores:gtopdb, infores:drugcentral; target_member: enforce primary-source membership in infores:panther; disease_member: enforce primary-source membership in infores:panther; member_count: enforce primary-source membership in infores:panther; The upstream regulator and downstream disease gene must be distinct.; The family must contain at most fourteen distinct GeneOrGeneProduct nodes through PANTHER member-of edges. Fourteen is the observed 90th percentile across all graph PANTHER families.; member_count denotes a complete neighborhood count, not one existential TRAPI match

limitations: Unknown predictions are unlabeled, not known negatives.
Canonical graph identifiers are deduplicated; parallel evidence does not multiply gene support.
Shared evolutionary family does not establish equivalent function, tissue expression, or regulatory direction.
